errors.text: The proposed critical L12 order-parameter threshold of approximately 0.4-0.5, interface roughness threshold, 100-hour aging duration, and narrow 580-620°C boundary are not supported by the supplied evidence or hidden target.
Ductility recovery at 750°C is attributed mainly to interface smoothing, whereas the target specifically invokes reduced ordering together with ductile transition zones along phase boundaries.
The cited studies concern materially different alloy systems and do not directly establish APBE, L12 ordering, jagged B2/FCC boundaries, or the brittle window in AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
